Eventually, the truck arrives at a small barbed wire gate. The man guarding the gate asks for ID, and the elder holds out his card and speaks some sort of shibboleth to the man. The guard then nods, and lets the truck through. Driving across the tarmac, they then park near a small airplane, a Metroliner, marked with what Ahmed can only assume is the livery of some local carrier.

"Right." Grant speaks. "Get off the truck, and let's start moving this stuff into the plane. Be quick, but don't be suspicious. People are going to notice if we're acting shady."

Unbeknownst to the men, the airport is already catching onto their game. From their tower, the air traffic controllers have been watching the plane from a distance, trying to figure out what exactly is going on. With the arrival of the truck, some of them have been all but certain that some sort of shady business is happening; that being said, it is still too early to confirm.

--------------------------- 
Mario's Family Drama 
--------------------------- 
On April 2nd, 2028, 20-year-old daughter of Mario Mario, Marietta Mario, famous for her beauty and her nickname "The Romariian Waifu," was discovered to have converted to Islam. This discovery caused huge political backlash from both her family and most of the Christian and non-Muslim population. 

According to Marietta, she converted to Islam due to having a dream of the Prophet appearing in front of her, and then in the dream she saw the wonders the Muslim people have made throughout history.

The situation has created an awkward political divide inside the ruling family itself. Some members of the Mario family reportedly attempted to convince Marietta to reconsider her decision, but failed, while others have chosen to remain silent to avoid escalating the already tense religious climate in Imperium Romae Marii. Mario Mario himself has stated that Marietta is hard-headed and does what she wants when talking with her family and said that it will not change any time soon.

Tensions between Muslim Romariians and the Mario family have slightly decreased due to Marietta's conversion, but only in relation to Marietta herself. Many Muslim Romariians and Muslim Dutch Residents have begun supporting and protecting her from criticism online and in public spaces, they have called it "The Protection".

However, most of this so-called Protection has not been peaceful. Reports across social media platforms show organized harassment campaigns, cyberbullying between both Muslims and Non-Muslims (particularly Christians), and several violent street confrontations between supporters and critics of Mariettas conversion. 

Most of these violent confrontations have occurred within the Romariia Federal Group, while the Isle Federal Group has experienced the least amount of conflict, due to the smaller population and the long running Xahu Island dispute with [nation]Yulandburg[/nation], which has kept the locals of the Federal Group focused for the past decade.

The Nedereland Federal Group appears divided, with northern regions experiencing violent incidents, while the southern regions remain largely peaceful. Observers have noted that Northern Nedereland has a higher Christian population than Southern Nedereland, which may or may not be contributing to the difference in tensions.

Are these tensions going to stop anytime soon? Or are they part of something bigger?

Han Ryung-sori is the current user of the [b]musi mildeut[/b], a 27 years old woman with slim body ,black hair and green eyes and long legs, she wears usually simple black pants and a white shirt but with also a hat with a white feather over it, a rare case of a individual Jaysunim who does not tax and instead lives on the sea with her "right hand" Ryu Soon in her own skiff boat, instead of taxing they simply exist out there by exploring the seas around the Hyunseoan archipelago and, occasionally work for the navy in conjunct missione, since she does not serve nor the government but also is not a traditional jaysunim, abs can work for both, her and Soon.
In the port of Yeongmeyon in particular, she and Soon remained in the top of a rooftop watching the sun to set.
[i]I always liked how the solar rays can....[/i]
Ryung would try some poetic speech, but, Soon had cut her mid phrase.
[i]Oh please not again my lady...[/i]
Ryung showed a fake breath, a rather dramatic of her, in response and soon answered:
[i]Do not be so rude! You cultural killer.[/i]
Soon rolled his eyes thought but with a subtle side smile into his face.
[i]I prevented you from reciting me [b]3 hours[/b] of golden water drops with the sunlight, you sanity killer
[/i]
The immediate reaction of Ryung was to put the hand on her chest, pretending to be offended.
[i][b]Three hours[/b]!? How absurd, I would say 2 hours and half of pure maritime poetry.[/i]
Despite giving a heavy breath, Soon could not really think of any good answer for that, instead, he remained silent, and adjusted the clock into his wrist and then looked to the sea.
[i]So my lady....are you accepting the exploration mission the government has given?[/i]
The only response Ryung could give was a simple nod into concordance.
[i]Our hearts ask for sea indeed....but the Dao offering is tempting, isn't it?[/i]
Soon would smile more confident now before answering.
[i]So we accept it?[/i]
But Ryung could.only roll her eyes and then took off her shoes to the ground, and soon used her powers to slide through the rooftop to the ground, landing precisely into the shoes, a silly yet funny trick she would do by using her powers.
[i]I still have to think it with my fleet...[/i]
[i]Our "fleet" has....2 members and a skiff[/i]
Soon would say in a rather sarcastic way before also going  down to the ground,.waiting for Ryung decision, who finally had...decided the following:
[i]Fine fine, we'll decide it better....after getting some snacks first.[/i]
She would point to a tent selling some crab with tangerines, without waiting for the answer if her first mate, Ryung once again used her slippery powers to slide around the Yeongmeyon port with Soon accompanying her right behind to eat something in the tent she pointed, as soon as she arrived, Ryung would take off her hat and greet:
[i]Greetings dearie, how's the sea been treating your business?[/i]
The vendor was an older man with a gray beard and hands permanently smelling of salt and tangerines looked up from the steaming pot. When he saw who it was, he gave a crooked smile.
[i]Well, well if it isn't the slippery skiff Ryung.[/i]
He pointed with a tangerine at Ryung.
[i]The seas been treating us well as it should.[/i]
Soon stopped beside her, crossing her arms as she observed the stall.
[i]Hey hey old man, don't you try to get into poetry debates, I swear...if this happens I'm taking this skiff and leaving![/i]
The vendor however, only would laugh and say.
[i]Alrigh alright, no fancy words today huh[/i]...
Soon rested his elbow on the makeshift counter, tilting his head with a provocation at Ryung.
[i]See, my lady? Sometimes leaving the poetry about seafoods opens dors...
[/i]
Feigning pain, Ryung crossed her arms and answered:
[i]How cruel. The tragedy of a misunderstood artist[/i]
The vendor was already serving two simple dishes: crab broken into pieces, seasoned with coarse salt and a few slices of tangerine squeezed on top. The smell was strong and sweet at the same time.
Ryung took the first dish.
[i]Ah now that's...better than hearing your complains Soon[/i]..
He would grab his own dish and take a bite before saying;
[i]Lies are bad, you know my lady?.[/i]
